title: INSTRUMENT PANEL-REINFORCEMENT & PAD ASM.
summary: Instrument panel pad (dash pad / crash pad with the defroster grille strip along the windshield), all models. The pad's front edge hooks over the lower windshield inner frame (View A); it is held by a screw up through a center reinforcement bracket and by screws up through a housing under its left end. Related: the pad's center reinforcement is screwed to the panel structure.

fastening.to: instrument panel / lower windshield inner frame at center
fastening.note: One screw [3] goes up from below through the hole in reinforcement [2] into the underside of the pad [1] (dashed center line from the pad). The second screw [3] goes in at an angle through the lower flange of the reinforcement into the panel structure.

fastening.to: underside of the LH end of the pad
fastening.note: Screw [4] goes up from below through a mounting tab of housing [5] into the pad [1]; the housing has tabs at its corners with dashed lines up to the pad.
View A: the front (windshield) edge of the pad [1] hooks over the flange of the LWR W/S INNER FRAME ASM.

notes: LWR W/S INNER FRAME ASM. (View A)
